summary_en: 570,000 shares (1.34% S/O) / ¥1,000M upper limit / open-market purchase / Aug 13 – Sep 30, 2026 / no price ceiling disclosed / stated objective: capital-efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Plus Alpha Consulting Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime, code 4071) announced on 12 August 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire up to 570,000 treasury shares (1.34% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate outlay of ¥1,000 million. The acquisition will be executed as open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 13 August and 30 September 2026. No upper price limit per share is disclosed. The company cites capital-efficiency improvement and fuller shareholder returns as the stated rationale. As of 30 June 2026, the company held zero treasury shares against 42,402,150 shares issued and outstanding (excluding treasury).
